stem.text: Two gliders are travelling towards each other on a horizontal air track. Glider P has mass $0.30\,\text{kg}$ and is moving with a constant speed of $1.2\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. Glider Q has mass $0.60\,\text{kg}$ and is moving with a constant speed of $1.8\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.

stem.alt: Horizontal air track with two gliders, labelled glider P (mass 0.30 kg) and glider Q (mass 0.60 kg), with velocity arrows labelled 1.2 m s-1 and 1.8 m s-1 and an air supply at the left end.

stem.text: The gliders have a perfectly elastic collision.
What are the speeds of the two gliders after the collision?
